en.headline: Centre warns against French Camembert over bacteria risk
en.dek: A 250-gram Camembert batch imported by Repertoire Culinaire has been taken off sale after an EU alert.
body: The Centre for Food Safety on Wednesday told the public not to eat a batch of prepackaged Camembert imported from France, after a notice that it might be contaminated with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli.

The product is Camembert Bertrand Crémier in 250-gram packs, best before 17 October 2026, batch number 232511. The importer is Repertoire Culinaire Hong Kong Limited. The centre said it had been alerted through the European Commission's Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed, and that a preliminary check found the importer had brought in the affected batch.

The importer has stopped sale, removed the batch from shelves and started a recall, the centre said. Members of the public can call the importer's hotline on 3758 2754 during office hours about the recall. Traders holding the product were told to stop using or selling it.

The centre said the bacteria can spread through water and food, and that eating contaminated food that has not been thoroughly cooked can cause intestinal illness. Some infected people may develop intestinal bleeding or serious complications such as haemolytic uraemic syndrome. The investigation is continuing.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食一批法國軟芝士
zh.dek: Camembert Bertrand Crémier批次232511或受產志賀毒素大腸桿菌污染，進口商已停售並回收。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心星期三呼籲市民不要食用一批法國進口的預先包裝芝士，指產品可能受產志賀毒素大腸桿菌污染。業界如持有受影響產品，應立即停止使用或出售。
涉事產品為Camembert Bertrand Crémier，每包250克，此日期或之前食用為2026年10月17日，批次編號232511，進口商為Repertoire Culinaire Hong Kong Limited。中心說，通報來自歐盟委員會食品和飼料快速預警系統，初步調查發現該進口商曾進口受影響批次。
進口商已按中心指示停售、下架並展開回收。市民可在辦公時間致電3758 2754查詢回收事宜。中心已通知業界，並會繼續跟進。
中心表示，產志賀毒素大腸桿菌可經水和食物傳播，進食未煮熟及受污染的食物可引致腸道傳染病，部分人可能出現腸出血，或溶血尿毒症等嚴重併發症。調查仍在進行。
